title: Lead from the Front
description: Four recruits off the same drills you ran - Denna, Oskar, Petrik, Ythan - and a goblin camp near Thornfield. They're yours. I'm not promising you that all four walk back.

objectives.description: Muster Denna, Oskar, Petrik and Ythan in Thornfield
Lead the squad's assault on the goblin camp
Bring down the shaman leading the camp
Get at least three of the four out alive
Report to Steele who made it back and who didn't

notes: Named recruits Denna, Oskar, Petrik, Ythan - invented, no bible basis, local colour to answer Step 3's 'soldiers die' directive. Threat: a green squad against a goblin camp, one may not return even on success. Giver motive: Steele needs to know you can command before he trusts you with contracts, not just a kill count. Consequence: keep_squad_alive only requires 3 of 4 - the data allows one death as a pass, which the prose should not soften. mercenary_12 reuses Denna and Oskar as veterans if this thread is picked up later.
